messages:
maria: Uploaded zephyr-13b weights to s3://redwood-models/onboard/zephyr-13b/v1/ (sharded x8). kicking off preflight now, PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412

jason: thanks. quick heads-up — previous zephyr variants had a tokenizer quirk (duplicate BOS on conversion). @sophia can you run a tokenization smoke? :eyes:

sophia: running now. quick command I use:
```
python infra/tokenizer_inspect.py \
  --weights s3://redwood-models/onboard/zephyr-13b/v1/ \
  --samples "Hello world\nHow are you?" \
  --show-special
```

sophia: output snippet shows: [BOS, BOS, 154, 23, 8, ...] — so duplicate BOS present. looks like conversion script duplicated bos_id when merging special tokens.

maria: ack. I updated the model_config.json in the PR to include our preflight flags:
```
{
  "model_name": "zephyr-13b",
  "weights_path": "s3://redwood-models/onboard/zephyr-13b/v1/",
  "max_seq_len": 2048,
  "kv_cache": true,
  "quant_profile": "awq",
  "awq_bits": 4,
  "fallback": "gptq-8"
}
```

jason: nice. on quant: ran AWQ calibration with ~6k calibration sequences (mix conv+instruction). perf: ~2.1x token throughput vs fp16, perplexity +1.8%. latency 95th still within our SLO for short contexts.

ryan: those numbers look good for a canary. tradeoff note: GPTQ-8 on the same weights gives slightly better ppl on long contexts (delta ~0.9%) but worse throughput. I propose AWQ-4 primary canary, GPTQ-8 fallback for sessions >1024 tokens.

lex: make sure rollout policy includes route_by: ["latency_slo","context_len"] and fallback variants. e.g. in console rollout config: `policy: {primary: zephyr-13b-awq-4, fallback: zephyr-13b-gptq-8, route_threshold: 1024}`

sophia: on tokenizer fix — opened a tiny patch to strip duplicate BOS on conversion and reserialize tokenizer. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizers/pull/98. quick unit I added:
```
assert tokenize("Hello")[0] == BOS
assert tokenize("Hello")[1] != BOS
```

maria: thanks @sophia. QA: can we run a small eval suite (30 prompts) to check output parity before canary? @qa-bot please run eval with the awq calibrations and return top-level metrics.

qa-bot: scheduled eval job #789. config: model=zephyr-13b-awq-4, dataset=onboard/zephyr-calib-30, metrics=[ppl,exact_match,bleu]. ETA ~18m.

qa-bot: eval complete. summary: ppl delta +1.9% vs fp16, EM -0.4pp, BLEU -0.6. no catastrophic regressions. full log: s3://redwood-results/evals/789/summary.json

jason: thanks. that's in line with calibration runs. I suggest a 24h canary with 5% traffic, route 0-1024 tokens AWQ-4, >1024 GPTQ-8. also recommend prefix/KV cache enabled to reduce repeated token cost.

ryan: +1 for that plan. one ask: please include a metric alert on quality regression (EM drop >1pp or ppl >3%) to auto-roll back.

maria: will add alerts. scheduling canary for Tue 09:00 PST. @lex can you set up rollout in Console and add the rollback policy?

lex: on it. will create rollout config and schedule. also adding a canary tag so logs show variant. link when ready.

sophia: patched tokenizer merged and new wheel built. I pushed a smoke image to staging `ghcr.io/redwood/zephyr-13b:staging-20260316`. ran a few smoke prompts, looks sane.

maria: ok final ask: reviewers pls ack PRs (models#412, tokenizers#98). once both green, I'll schedule the canary. any objections?

jason: sg :thumbsup:

ryan: ok from me. watch the EM/bleu alerts closely first hour.

lex: no objections. deployment policy will include fallback and rollback alert.

maria: thanks everyone. taggin the deploy bot now. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: zephyr-13b-awq-4 -> 5% traffic -> 2026-03-17T09:00:00-08:00. Rollback on quality-alert or infra errors.

maria: will follow up with a short post-canary checklist and results snapshot. thanks! :heart:
